hypothesis.statement: On a real eyes-closed posterior EEG channel (eegmmidb S002R02, POz), the newly-authored adfTest reproduces the statsmodels.tsa.stattools.adfuller(autolag=None) statistic BIT-FOR-BIT; and the statistic lies well below the 5% Dickey-Fuller critical value, rejecting the unit-root null in favour of stationarity.

analysis_plan.dataset: EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Database (eegmmidb, PhysioNet), subject S002, baseline run R02 (eyes-closed), channel POz (posterior), first 10 s at 160 Hz (1600 samples)

decision.threshold: descriptive: adfTest equals statsmodels adfuller to machine precision (|diff| < 1e-9); the statistic is below the 5% critical value
